description: This file defines the InsideViewLogicHook class, which provides methods to generate InsideView URLs for different CRM entities (Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity) and to display an embedded frame in the CRM interface, integrating InsideView data.

classes.name: InsideViewLogicHook
classes.description: A class providing methods to generate InsideView URLs for CRM entities and to display an embedded InsideView frame within the CRM interface.

methods.name: handleFieldMap
methods.description: Constructs a URL-encoded query string from a bean object and a field mapping, handling nested arrays for multiple source fields.

methods.name: getAccountFrameUrl
methods.description: Builds the InsideView URL for an Account entity, including relevant address and account info.

methods.name: getOpportunityFrameUrl
methods.description: Builds the InsideView URL for an Opportunity entity.

methods.name: getLeadFrameUrl
methods.description: Builds the InsideView URL for a Lead entity.

methods.name: getContactFrameUrl
methods.description: Builds the InsideView URL for a Contact entity.

methods.name: showFrame
methods.description: Main method to generate and display the InsideView iframe in the DetailView of a CRM record, based on the entity type.
